The Movement

Meet The Team

Runners Leading The Movement

GM01
Founding Ambassador
Bubul Khonikor
The Guru

A true pioneer of Assam's running culture and founder of Duronto Run Club - Assam's very first running club.

Read story

Bubul Khonikor brings a dynamic energy to the Guwahati Marathon, backed by a legacy few can match. A true pioneer of Assam's running culture, he was among the first to bring structured running coaching to the state and founded Duronto Run Club - Assam's very first running club. A founding ambassador of the Guwahati Marathon, Bubul carries forward his life's mission: proving that endurance sport doesn't just build athletes, it transforms lives. Fittingly known as the Guru, he continues to inspire a generation to lace up and start running.

GM02
Founding Ambassador
Dr. Santanu Dutta
The Iron Doctor

Five-time Comrades finisher, two World Majors, 4 Ironmans - by day a radiologist, on race day an endurance legend.

Read story

By day, Dr Santanu Dutta commands precision as a radiologist; on race day, he's one of India's most decorated endurance athletes. A five-time consecutive finisher of South Africa's brutal 90km Comrades Marathon, he has also conquered two World Majors - Berlin and Chicago - alongside 4 Ironman triathlons (including a full Ironman in Australia), 26+ ultramarathons, and 50+ half marathons across continents. A founding Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Dr Dutta proves that with discipline and grit, no finish line is too far.

GM03
Founding Ambassador
Dr. Pranami Chakravarty
The Ultra Endurance Icon

First woman from Northeast India to conquer 100 miles. First from Assam to complete a 100K ultra.

Read story

Dr. Pranami Chakravarty doesn't just practice medicine - she rewrites what's possible for women in endurance sport. The first woman from Northeast India to conquer 100 miles, and the first from Assam to complete a 100K ultra, she brings the same precision and grit to the trails that she brings to her patients. For her, running isn't escape - it's meditation, discipline, and pure fire. Now in her second year as a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Dr. Pranami continues to push limits and prove that greatness is built one relentless mile at a time.

GM04
Founding Ambassador
Sagarika Bhagawati
The Stride Queen

From Sohra to Ladakh to Bangkok - one of the very few women from Assam to complete a 100K ultramarathon.

Read story

From her first 10K at Sohra in 2016 to running at nearly 18,000 feet on the Ladakh Marathon trails, Sagarika Bhagawati has turned endurance into a way of life. She stormed the Hennur Bamboo Ultra 100K and placed 4th overall at the Anvayins Run for the Rhino 52K in Kaziranga, becoming one of the very few women from Assam to complete a 100K ultramarathon. In 2025, she took her stride international at the Bangkok Marathon. A founding Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Sagarika is living proof that the only limits are the ones we don't challenge.

GM05
Founding Ambassador
Junali Patir
Long-Distance Runner

Driven by a love for long-distance running and a mission to inspire more people to discover the joy of running.

Read story

Junali Patir's journey into running is nothing short of remarkable. Her dedication to personal growth and fitness has made her a role model in her community, fuelled by a love for long-distance running and a drive to conquer every challenge in her path. As a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Junali's mission is simple: inspire more people to discover the joy of running.

GM06
Founding Ambassador
Anupam Deka
Endurance Champion

Founder of Mind Over Miles. Comrades finisher. Berlin World Major. Mission: put North East India on the global endurance map.

Read story

Anupam Deka didn't just take up running - he built a movement around it. Founder of Mind Over Miles, he has conquered the Comrades Marathon, the Berlin Marathon (an Abbott World Major), and the brutal Khardung La Challenge alongside dozens of trail and ultra races across India. After two decades in IT, he walked away from the corporate grind to chase something bigger: using endurance sport to fuel wildlife conservation, rural tourism, and community change across the Northeast. A founding Guwahati Marathon ambassador, his mission is audacious - put North East India on the global endurance map.

GM07
Founding Ambassador
Prathibhu Dutta
The Parking-Lot Trainer

Champions don't need perfect conditions. From a parking lot to Tata Mumbai Marathon - built on relentless discipline.

Read story

Prathibhu Dutta's story is proof that champions don't need perfect conditions - his journey began with cycling, evolved into running, and turned an ordinary parking lot into a battleground for personal bests. From surviving an 8-hour stadium run to conquering marathons like the Tata Mumbai Marathon, the Kalimpong Ultra, and the Kaziranga Trail Run, he has built a career on relentless discipline. Returning as a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Prathibhu leads not with words but with miles - proving that grit, more than talent, gets you to the finish line.

GM08
New This Edition
Shenaz Farmin
Banker. Bodybuilder. Ultra Runner.

From her first 10K in 2023 to the Border Hell Race 100K in 15h37m - 1st place at Guwahati Marathon 2025.

Read story

Shenaz Farmin's endurance journey began with one 10K at the Coal India Marathon, Guwahati, in December 2023 - and it changed her life. Since then, she's logged 2 ultramarathons (100K and 65K), 4 full marathons, and 20+ half marathons, claiming a Procam Slam title, 1st place at Guwahati Marathon 2025, and the Border Hell Race 100K in 15h37m. A founding Guwahati Marathon ambassador, she's now training for the 2026 Khardungla Challenge. Her sign-off says it all: if you've ever thought 'I can't' - lace up, show up, and run with her.

GM09
New This Edition
Dr. Meenakshi Hariharan
Strength in Balance

Infectious disease specialist. 2nd Fittest Woman in India (2020). Hyrox podium. Official pacer TCS World 10K.

Read story

Dr. Meenakshi Hariharan is proof that medicine and elite fitness can thrive together. An infectious diseases specialist at Down Town Hospital, Guwahati, she's also a decade-long CrossFit athlete crowned 2nd Fittest Woman in India (POF 2020) and a 2025 Hyrox podium finisher against international competition. A dedicated runner, she completed the Procam Slam and serves as an official pacer for the TCS World 10K. A founding Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Dr. Meenakshi champions balance of mind, body, and purpose - with a philosophy she lives daily: consistency is everything, because life is what you make it.

GM10
Founding Ambassador
Mamoni Hazarika
Endurance Runner

Tata Mumbai Marathon, Airtel Delhi Half Marathon, Kaziranga Ultra - from 21K to 52K, built on grit and determination.

Read story

With a resume spanning iconic marathons like the Tata Mumbai Marathon, the Airtel Delhi Half Marathon, and the Kaziranga Ultra, Mamoni Hazarika is a powerhouse of endurance. From 21K to 52K, her journey is built on grit and determination. Returning as a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Mamoni continues to inspire runners to embrace every challenge and strive for excellence.

GM11
Founding Ambassador
Mrityunjoy
Miles & Smiles

Solang Sky Ultra. Malnad 50K. 63K Guwahati Stadium Run. Chasing mountains with coffee and an unstoppable smile.

Read story

Mrityunjoy doesn't just chase mountains - he conquers them, one ultra at a time. From high-altitude treks to brutal races like the Solang Sky Ultra and Malnad 50K, his journey is built on relentless passion. Last year, he powered through the 63K Guwahati Stadium Run in a blistering 8 hours - fuelled, as always, by a good cup of coffee and an unstoppable smile. Now in his second year as a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Mrityunjoy keeps raising the bar, proving that boundaries exist only until someone decides to run past them.

GM12
Founding Ambassador
Ruchi Bharadwaj
Fitness Consultant

Former professor, mother, fitness consultant. Over a decade guiding 1,000+ individuals toward healthier lives.

Read story

A fitness consultant, former professor, and mother, Ruchi Bharadwaj's journey is one of strength and transformation. Over the past decade, she has guided over 1,000 individuals toward healthier lifestyles while excelling in calisthenics and strength training. Now in her second year as a Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Ruchi continues to inspire with her dedication to health and empowerment.

GM13
New This Edition
Hima Chetri
Fitness Influencer

Fitness influencer, runner, and mother - proving that running fits into any lifestyle, one step at a time.

Read story

Fitness influencer, runner, and mother, Hima Chetri brings a relatable, everyday energy to the Guwahati Marathon. Balancing family life with a passion for fitness, she motivates her community to move more and live healthier - proving that running fits into any lifestyle, one step at a time.

GM14
Founding Ambassador
Shweta Himatsingka
Nutritionist & Health Coach

Celebrity nutritionist, health coach, marathon runner - inspiring thousands to prioritise wellness as a lifestyle.

Read story

A powerhouse of wellness and a proud Guwahati Marathon ambassador, Shweta Himatsingka redefines fitness with every step she takes. As a celebrity nutritionist, health coach, and marathon runner, she inspires thousands to prioritise wellness and prove that fitness is a lifestyle, not a phase. Her journey - from empowering individuals with transformative health solutions to embracing the marathon spirit - is nothing short of inspiring.
